text:
Keiko Tanaka: Quick brainstorm for end-of-year Culture Hub: set up a 'Kudos Rail' (a rolling board where people pin short shout-outs) + pop-up micro-ceremonies every afternoon next week. Mix of physical and remote. Thoughts?
Darnell Price: Love the rail idea. How long is each micro-ceremony? 5 min tops?
Keiko Tanaka: yes 3-5 min spotlight per award, keep it snappy.
Sophia V: Logistics: need clear rules for nominations. Are managers allowed to nominate or is it peer-only? Also eligibility windows for recent joiners.
Janet Cole: HR POV: make it peer-first but allow manager nominations in exceptional cases. Eligibility: must be with company >2 weeks. We'll add that to the form.
Liam O'Neal: Volunteer needs: 1 MC per ceremony, 1 photographer (or a volunteer with phone), 1 person to handle remote nominations. I can MC daytime slots.
Keiko Tanaka: budget? proposing $10-$30 e-gifts for micro-ceremonies and 3 larger 'Culture Champion' $150 awards.
Janet Cole: Finance: OK for small e-gifts. Anything over $100 needs approval and tracking. We'll need PO and vendor tax info.
people-bot: Reminder: use `/issue-spot-award <recipient> <amount> <reason>` to record awards. Tag events with `#culture-hub` for reporting.
Darnell Price: vendor note: prefer e-gift CSV upload. If shipping physical swag to remote folks, collect addresses via secure form.
Sophia V: I'll build the nomination form (Google Form) with required fields + photo consent. Link will update the sheet.
Keiko Tanaka: poster and Slack banner copy drafts in the doc. Also thinking of a small "gratitude postcard" station where folks write notes.
Liam O'Neal: postcard station sounds great. Facilities can provide a cork strip to hang them as a backdrop for the rail.
Janet Cole: Legal: include short data-use language for addresses and photo release. Also flag if any award influencer or contest implications (make sure it's recognition, not a sweepstakes).
Sophia V: added consent checkbox and short text: "I consent to Redwood using my contribution and photo for internal comms and optional external channels."
Darnell Price: timeline: nomination form live by Mon; posters printed Tue; PO requested Wed; volunteer roster finalized Thu.
Keiko Tanaka: can we have an anonymized leaderboard by team? just for fun.
Janet Cole: leaderboard okay if opt-in. Add opt-out toggle on form.
people-bot: Event automation: scheduled reminders will DM volunteers 24h before their slot. Use tag `#culture-hub` when issuing awards to include in the year-end report.
Liam O'Neal: also request a roll-up sheet for analytics: count of kudos, awards issued, remote vs in-person. I can build a dashboard if we get the CSV.
Keiko Tanaka: action items: Sophia build form + sheet; Janet draft eligibility & legal blurb; Darnell sort vendor options; Liam compile volunteers and MC schedule; Keiko finalize poster copy.
Janet Cole: will loop in Finance for PO template and cc @James R on approvals.
Sophia V: form draft: https://docs.google.com/forms/culturehub-noms (sharing in sheet).
Darnell Price: vendor shortlist added to procurement tab. E-gift vendor supports bulk codes + CSV.
Keiko Tanaka: awesome. closing thread for now, will reopen if any blockers. :confetti_ball:
